content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Centralized payment platforms fail creators in Ghana because they rely on legacy banking systems and regional restrictions. COREMERCH’s infrastructure bypasses these bottlenecks by leveraging decentralized tools. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store for free, ensuring global accessibility. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. Supabase stores orders securely, and Google Drive delivers files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. This stack is sovereign—you own every component. No platform can shut you down. No subscription fees. No geographic locks. It’s built to withstand the exact failures that exclude you from Stripe and PayPal. This isn’t a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in regions where traditional systems collapse.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather three essentials: a digital product ready to sell, a domain name (optional but recommended), and a crypto wallet to receive payments. Your product—ebook, course, template—must be finalized and stored in a format ready for delivery. A domain name (e.g., yourname.com) adds professionalism but isn’t required; GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages can host your store under a free subdomain. Your crypto wallet should support BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10. If you’re new to crypto, set up a wallet on Trust Wallet or MetaMask. Finally, decide which COREMERCH stack fits your needs: Sovereign Starter Stack for simplicity or Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features. The Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints and templates for $197—a one-time investment for lifetime infrastructure ownership.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your payment pipeline with NOWPayments. Sign up for a free account, select your preferred cryptocurrency (BSC, Solana, or TRON), and generate API keys. Integrate these keys into your backend—Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—to verify payments automatically. Next, set up product delivery. Upload your digital files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Write a script to generate secure, time-limited download links after payment confirmation. For order storage, use Supabase or Google Sheets to log transactions. Test each component: simulate a payment, verify the webhook fires, and ensure the download link works. This pipeline is modular—each piece functions independently but integrates seamlessly. Once configured, it runs automatically, 24/7, without your intervention.
Own your infrastructure. No gatekeepers. No subscriptions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Connect your domain (if using one) and ensure SSL is enabled for secure transactions. Test the live environment by purchasing your product with a small crypto payment. Verify that NOWPayments confirms the transaction, your backend generates a download link, and the file delivers successfully. Monitor the process in Supabase or Google Sheets to confirm the order is logged. If any step fails, check your backend logic and API integrations. Once live, share your store link with your audience. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works. Every subsequent sale follows the same automated process—no manual intervention required. You’ve now bypassed the gatekeepers and built a system that works anywhere, for anyone.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure live, focus on scaling. Add more products by uploading files to your delivery system and updating your backend logic. Use Cloudflare Workers to handle increased traffic without additional costs. Monitor transaction fees and adjust your preferred cryptocurrency network if fees rise. Implement email notifications using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to keep customers informed. For advanced users, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC to ensure delivery of transactional emails. The Complete Builder Kit includes scaling playbooks and templates to streamline this process. As your sales grow, your infrastructure scales automatically—no upgrades, no subscriptions. You’re not renting a platform; you’re owning a system built to grow with your business.

Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. This stack is decentralized, meaning no single platform controls your business. You own every component, ensuring lifetime access and no geographic restrictions. It’s designed for creators in regions like Ghana, where traditional payment platforms fail. Deploy once, and the infrastructure runs automatically, processing payments and delivering products without your intervention.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Finalize your digital product and store it in a deliverable format. 2. Set up a crypto wallet supporting BSC, Solana, or TRON. 3. Choose a domain name (optional) or use a free subdomain from GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Sign up for NOWPayments, select your cryptocurrency, and generate API keys. 5. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Configure your backend (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script) to verify payments and generate download links. 7. Set up order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 8. Test the entire pipeline: simulate a payment, verify the webhook, and ensure file delivery. 9. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 10. Process your first live transaction and monitor the system.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m new to crypto?

Yes. The system integrates with NOWPayments, which handles crypto transactions automatically. You don’t need to manage wallets manually. Set up a wallet on Trust Wallet or MetaMask, select a low-fee network like BSC, and let the infrastructure handle the rest.
What happens if a payment fails?

If a payment fails, NOWPayments won’t fire the webhook, and your backend won’t generate a download link. The buyer can retry the payment, and the system will process it automatically once confirmed on-chain.
Do I need to pay monthly fees for this infrastructure?
No. The tools used—GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Google Drive—are free. NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. You own the infrastructure after deployment, with no recurring costs.
Can I sell to customers outside Ghana?

Yes. This infrastructure is designed for global sales. Your store is hosted on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, ensuring fast access worldwide. Crypto payments work across borders, removing geographic restrictions.
How do I add more products to my store?

Upload new files to your delivery system (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2) and update your backend logic to include the additional products. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates to streamline this process.
